name: Hanani
bio: Hanani the seer confronted King Asa of Judah after Asa paid Ben-Hadad of Aram to attack Israel rather than trusting the LORD, who had once given him victory over a far larger army under Zerah the Cushite. Hanani warned that Asa's reliance on a foreign king instead of the LORD, whose eyes range throughout the earth to strengthen those fully committed to him, was foolish and would bring wars from then on. Asa, furious, had Hanani thrown into prison (2 Chronicles 16:7-10). He was the father of the prophet Jehu, who later confronted both Baasha of Israel and Jehoshaphat of Judah.
